 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 28 October 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Choices. Everything is a result of the choices you make, Pisces . Not consequences, but results. You see how a shift in one tiny word changes the way you perceive a situation. So instead of fearing the worst and fretting over making the ‘wrong’ decision, simply look at your choices as leading you to certain points and results. You will feel more in charge of your decisions instead of seeing them as one-way roads that lead to dead ends.
 Cosmic tip: Pick what feels most alluring and in sync with your energy.
